DK: Jobindex RSS q=lægesekretær + q=sundhedsadministrativ, 31 unique ads; 7 secretary ads with full hosted jobannonce bodies (4 in Region Hovedstaden / Sjælland: Roskilde, Holbæk Sygehus, Region Sjælland reumatologi, Rødovre), plus 10 hospital lægesekretær/SAK ads that are teaser-only (body on hr-manager), every one titled "lægesekretær eller sundhedsadministrativ koordinator" or equivalent, which backs the r4 education pin. SE: JobTech q=medicinsk sekreterare, 106 hits, 22 in Skåne län (Region Skåne, Kry, Capio, Praktikertjänst, Prima Vård, Vimera). Pooled n=29. Shares DK/SE/pooled: admin 100/100/100%; reception 100/95/97%; education 71/100/93%; independent 86/95/93%; team 86/91/90%; experience 71/91/86%; journal 43/86/76%; it 43/82/72%; language 14/86/69%; epr 43/73/66%; confidential 14/77/62%; service 71/55/59%; flex 29/64/55%; pathway 71/50/55%; referral 43/59/55%; structure 86/41/52%; coding 57/50/52%; booking 86/32/45%; pressure 57/14/24%; clinicassist 43/5/14%; quality 0/9/7%; ai 0/9/7%. No rank moved: the sample is smaller than 10-15 (n=49), the SE leg largely overlaps it, and the term lists were rebuilt, so gaps under ~20 points are method noise. WATCH: prior experience (r14) 86% pooled vs 55% on 10-15; prioritising under pressure (r16) 24% vs 49%. Quality registers 7% and AI/speech recognition 7% stay out. Prior: NEW cluster (MEDSEC-CLUSTER-001, owner 2026-10-15, for a user targeting East Denmark and Skåne). First top-20, ranked on pooled requirement shares from two requirement-level samples: (SE) JobTech open API, q=medicinsk sekreterare, 115 hits of which 30 in Skåne län (Region Skåne, Kry, Capio, Praktikertjänst, Doktor.se, Prima Vård; vårdcentraler, akutmottagning, ortopedi, BUP, habilitering, njurmedicin), full description.text tallied by script; (DK) Jobindex RSS q=lægesekretær, 20 hosted ads followed to the full jobannonce body, 19 with requirement text (4 in Region Hovedstaden / Sjælland, the rest west or unlocated; mostly almen praksis, speciallægepraksis, Aleris, Privathospitalet Danmark). Pooled n=49. Shares as DK/SE/pooled: r1 reception 63/97/84%; r2 team 63/90/80%; r3 service 68/87/80%; r4 education 37/87/67%; r5 journal 32/90/67%; r6 admin 58/73/67%; r7 epr 58/70/65%; r8 flex 37/80/63%; r9 independent 53/70/63%; r10 language 11/90/59%; r11 it 26/80/59%; r12 pathway 42/70/59%; r13 confidentiality 16/83/57%; r14 experience 53/57/55%; r15 booking 68/40/51%; r16 pressure 42/53/49%; r17 structure 47/50/49%; r18 referral 26/57/45%; r19 coding 11/60/41%; r20 clinicassist 37/0/14%. Dropped below r20: quality 31%. Two documented adjustments: the education item (SAK / lægesekretær / medicinsk sekreterare) is pinned no lower than r8 because every Region Hovedstaden and Region Sjælland hospital ad found names "uddannet lægesekretær eller sundhedsadministrativ koordinator" as the requirement while the DK practice sample also accepts klinikassistenter; clinic-assistant tasks (prøvetagning, EKG) are DK-general-practice only and sit at r20. Context: Region Hovedstaden + Region Sjælland merge into Region Østdanmark on 2027-01-01; Region Skåne ads name Melior, PASiS, Medspeech, 1177 and diagnos/KVÅ-kodning as standing duties; Region H ads name Sundhedsplatformen as known or an advantage. The Danish sundhedsadministrativ koordinator education (2.5 years, KP) replaced the lægesekretær education; its modules (sundhedsadministration & koordinering, sundhed & sygdom, kommunikation, jura, teknologi & data) back the education, language, pathway and confidentiality items. HK Kommunal: hospital lægesekretær FTEs down 9.2% (800 positions) since 2015, a supply gap, not a demand signal. Weekly runs re-tally both samples (routine prompt step 1).
